description: This file defines a thread class Hl7InArchivesMigrateThread responsible for migrating HL7 archive data from the database to the filesystem within the OpenMRS healthcare platform. It manages migration progress, status, and execution control, encapsulating thread lifecycle and error handling.

classes.name: Hl7InArchivesMigrateThread
classes.description: A thread class managing the process of migrating HL7 archives from the database to the filesystem, including progress tracking and error handling.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: An enum representing the various states (RUNNING, STOPPED, COMPLETED, ERROR, NONE) of the migration thread.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the migration process in a separate thread, handling session management, invoking the HL7 service migration method, and updating status and progress.

methods.name: stopMigration
methods.description: Sets the migration status to STOPPED and disables the thread activity, effectively halting the migration process.
